label: Session
description: What a session carries between calls: the display name the directory gave at sign-in, the realm the sign-in decided, and the theme the caller chose, when one was. Named by the @auth plugin's settings.session, so every write through session.port.json is judged against it.

displayName.description: written at sign-in from the directory's name

realm.description: written at sign-in: customer or employee
